correctness.rationale: Using e_n=z^n/sqrt(n!), the two-step shift has coefficients b/sqrt(n+1), 2a sqrt((n+1)/(n+2)). Direct multiplication gives diagonal H_00=2|a|^2+|b|^2, H_11=8|a|^2/3-|b|^2/2, H_nn=8|a|^2/[n(n+2)]-|b|^2/[n(n+1)] (n>=2), and H_{n,n+1}=conj(a)b for n=0 and -2conj(a)b/[(n+2)sqrt(n+1)] otherwise. Absolute sums give trace class and exact telescoping trace 8|a|^2. Pure-case diagonal tails scale n^-2; mixed off-diagonal weighted shifts scale n^-3/2. Separating supports via PHQ compression makes p>2/3 necessary even for 0<p<1. Infinitely many disjoint indefinite adjacent principal blocks for ab!=0 prove both infinite inertias; zero and pure-symbol cases follow directly.
